citation: Altun, Bleda & Trindle, "Hydrogen Bonding in 3-hydroxy-2-butenamide and related isomers", Molecules 26, 2623 (2021), doi:10.3390/molecules26092623
license: CC BY 4.0; facts and numbers only; SI coordinates copied unchanged
topic: Eleven computed isomers and conformers of acetoacetamide and its enol tautomer (labelled ONE to ELEVEN) differ in their intramolecular hydrogen bonds.

facts.text: Relative electronic energies (kJ/mol, extrapolated to the complete-basis limit from HF, MP2 and CCSD): with OH···O, OH···N or NH···O bonds, TWO 0, ONE 4.0, FIVE +38, FOUR +42, ELEVEN +48; with only CH···O or CH···N contacts, SEVEN +38, SIX +43, TEN +61, NINE +91; with no hydrogen bond, THREE +62, EIGHT +101.
Ranked by local stretching force constant, the hydrogen bonds are TWO > ELEVEN > FIVE (all above 0.2 mdyn/Å), then ONE, FOUR and SIX, with the CH···N and CH···OH contacts weakest.

ask: Which statement about hydrogen bonding and the relative stability of these species is consistent with both facts?

hypotheses.text: Relative stability is a property of the whole molecule and is not explained by the strength of the local hydrogen bond alone.
hypotheses.locator: Results after Table 1: stability not simply explained by local H bonding
hypotheses.reason: 与全部事实一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: The stronger the local hydrogen bond, the lower the energy, so the energy order follows the hydrogen-bond ranking.
hypotheses.reason: ELEVEN 的氢键排第二强，能量却是 +48，高于只有 CH···N 的 SEVEN（+38）。

hypotheses.text: Species without any hydrogen bond are always the least stable ones.
hypotheses.reason: 有 CH···OH 接触的 NINE（+91）比完全没有氢键的 THREE（+62）还高。

hypotheses.text: CH···O and CH···N contacts contribute nothing, so species having only them are as unstable as species with no hydrogen bond.
hypotheses.reason: SEVEN（+38）、SIX（+43）明显低于无氢键的 THREE（+62），与含 XH···Y 的 FIVE（+38）相当。
